name: venusian-voyager/io-pools
description: The IOPool dock: resource drivers riding a cooperative loop tick, mail drained to the loop's one consumer.

suggest.ext-parallel: Required to use the thread worker-pool driver (ZTS builds only).
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required to stop the loop on SIGINT and SIGTERM, and for signal wakes on epoll and select.
suggest.php-io-extensions/epoll: Required to use the epoll waiter backend on Linux.
suggest.php-io-extensions/kqueue: Required to use the kqueue waiter backend on macOS and BSD.
suggest.react/promise: Required to use the react promise engine (^3.0).
